style: Cinematic illustrated realism, painterly matte-painting detail with a faint ink outline and paper grain, like a naturalist's field plate. Lit only by bioluminescence or a single lamp, never by direct sun. Palette by place: deep moss green, slate and glowing river cyan on the forested slopes; violet dusk, ice blue and teal on the peaks; matte black, cold white and seal red for the institution; warm paper, brown-black ink and pencil grey for the journal. Flat black redaction bars with fibrous ends are the one graphic intrusion. The scientist is always the same woman in her thirties: dark hair tied low, grey field jacket, dark trousers, worn brown canvas rucksack, seen from behind or by her hands. The archivist is only a dark hood and a pair of ink-stained hands, never a face.

images.title: The valley's edge, one bar across the sky
images.prompt: Cinematic illustrated realism, painterly matte-painting detail with a faint ink outline and paper grain, like a naturalist's field plate. Night. Seen from behind, small at the right of the frame, a woman in her thirties with dark hair tied low, grey field jacket, dark trousers and worn brown canvas rucksack stands on a rock lip above a forested mountain valley, an open notebook in her left hand. The valley below is strung with vast fine webs between crystalline-bark trees, glowing river cyan in waves that travel along the strands. A huge violet megapeak rises left of centre. One flat matte black redaction bar with fibrous ends lies straight across the sky like ink ruled on the picture, hiding the summit. Low horizon; the upper left sky above the bar is calm empty violet dusk, kept clear for a title. Lit only by the web's glow: moss green, slate, cyan, violet, black. Thin mist, pale crystal grass, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo

images.title: The valley's edge, one bar across the sky (tall)
images.prompt: Cinematic illustrated realism, painterly matte-painting detail with a faint ink outline and paper grain, like a naturalist's field plate. Night, vertical composition. In the centre of the frame a single enormous violet mountain, a steep megapeak, towers over a forested valley. One flat matte black horizontal redaction bar with fibrous ends is laid exactly over the top of the mountain, at one third of the way down the frame, covering its summit so the peak's slopes disappear up into the black bar. Everything above the bar, the whole top third of the picture, is plain empty calm violet dusk sky with nothing in it. At the bottom, small, seen from behind, a woman in her thirties with dark hair tied low, grey field jacket, dark trousers and worn brown canvas rucksack stands on a rock lip, an open notebook in her left hand. The valley between her and the mountain is strung with vast fine webs between crystalline-bark trees, glowing river cyan in waves along the strands. Lit only by the web's glow: moss green, slate, cyan, violet, black. Thin mist, pale crystal grass, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo
images.needs_review: Retry kept (first had no megapeak). The bar crosses the mountain below its summit, so the summit still shows above it in the title space, and the bar's ends carry a thin red edge.

images.title: The Redacted Testament: the archivist's desk
images.prompt: Cinematic illustrated realism, painterly matte-painting detail with a faint ink outline and paper grain, like a naturalist's field plate. A small bare underground room at night. A plain wooden desk seen from above and behind a seated hooded figure whose face is never visible; two ink-stained hands rest flat on the open pages of a field journal in the middle of the desk. One page is torn across. The journal's lines of tiny illegible brown-black handwriting are covered by solid flat black rectangular redaction bars, pure black ink only: some bars crooked and smeared, some ruled perfectly straight. No red anywhere, no crosses, no scribbles. Three more worn closed journals are stacked beside it, grey rock dust on their covers. The chair opposite is empty. In the dark behind, a closed heavy door with a thin line of cold white light beneath it. A single warm lamp is the only light: warm paper, iron-gall brown, bar black, slate shadow, faint blue ink on the fingers. The lower quarter is dark, empty desk wood, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo

images.title: The Archivist in Time: her name on the cover
images.prompt: Cinematic illustrated realism, painterly matte-painting detail with a faint ink outline and paper grain, like a naturalist's field plate. A cramped hidden room at night, wooden shutters closed, one candle lamp on a rough table. The camera is directly behind a seated woman, so only her back is seen and never her face: a woman in her thirties with dark hair tied low, grey field jacket dusted grey with rock dust, worn brown canvas rucksack on her back. She leans over the table writing on the plain cover of a battered closed journal; her hand covers what she writes. On the far side of the table, facing us, a second person is cut off by shadow: only a dark hooded sleeve and two ink-stained hands, pressing flat one loose cream paper page. On that page some lines are covered by solid black rectangular redaction bars and other lines show pale blue-stained blank strips where bars were washed away; no readable writing, no red. Two packed bags by a bolted door at the side; one thin blade of cold white light comes through the shutter slats. Warm candlelight, warm paper, iron-gall brown, bar black, slate shadow. The lower quarter is dark shadowed floor and chair back, calm and empty, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo
images.needs_review: Retry kept (first showed the scientist's face). The loose page shows red, teal and white strips instead of black bars and lifted pale-blue strips, and a blade-shaped blue glint sits by the door hinge.

images.title: Directed Resilience: a baseline for a species that did not exist yesterday
images.prompt: Cinematic illustrated realism, painterly matte-painting detail with a faint ink outline and paper grain, like a naturalist's field plate. A sterile laboratory inside a mountain, seamless matte black walls, cold white overhead light. Seen from behind, a woman in her thirties with dark hair tied low, grey field jacket, dark trousers and worn brown canvas rucksack, sits alone at a spotless white bench, her right hand writing measurements in a bound catalogue whose cover carries a round red wax seal. Under a glass dome before her stands a small unfamiliar plant with translucent teal fronds. At her left hand lie a steel rule and a broad black pen; one line of her page is already covered by a neat black bar. Through a long window, violet peaks in a new, smoother shape, their slopes bare: no terraces, no villages, no lights. Matte black, cold white, seal red, a little teal. The lower quarter is empty white bench surface, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo

images.title: Fire: silent water lifts, the river still glowing
images.prompt: Cinematic illustrated realism, painterly matte-painting detail with a faint ink outline and paper grain, like a naturalist's field plate. Dusk after a collapse: a wide still view of a mountainside where stepped stone farming terraces have slid away. Tall wooden water lifts stand motionless and tilted among broken drystone walls and slate tiles, wheels stopped, buckets hanging. Far below in the gorge the river still glows cyan, the only light, casting a cold glow up the rubble. Above, the skyline has dropped a tier: a raw pale scar where a summit was, dust hanging in the air. In the middle distance, small, back turned, a lone hooded figure kneels lifting a dusty journal from between stones, three more stacked beside. No one else, no flames. Slate grey, bone dust, dead moss green, river cyan, violet sky. The lower quarter is dark foreground rubble, calm, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo

images.title: Errata: the correction, unsigned
images.prompt: Cinematic illustrated realism, painterly matte-painting detail with a faint ink outline and paper grain, like a naturalist's field plate. Violet storm dusk on a high mountain ridge, the whole sky dark violet. Seen from behind at the left, a woman in her thirties with dark hair tied low, grey field jacket, dark trousers and worn brown canvas rucksack pins one single printed sheet to a single weathered timber post. The sheet shows only one small line diagram of a mountain slope at the top and a few faint grey ruled lines; the bottom third of the sheet is completely blank empty paper: no signature, no handwriting, no scribble, no marks. A sheaf of identical sheets is under her arm. Across a deep gorge, a small farming village of stepped drystone terraces and slate-roofed houses sits dark and emptied, shutters closed, wooden water lifts still, as a churning violet storm front rolls onto its upper tier. Far off on the mountain path, a line of tiny lantern points climbs away to safety, too distant to show any figure. Moss green, slate, violet storm light, a thread of glowing cyan river far below, warm paper. The lower quarter is dark ridge rock and pale crystal grass, calm, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo
images.needs_review: Retry kept (first showed signed sheets on a notice board). A faint signature-like scribble still sits at the bottom of the sheet, which must be unsigned; the sheet is also oversized.
